name: Critical Visit
source:
Meet Alex the main character in the visual novel. Unlike teenagers of his age,
he loves to spend the break with his favorited aunt Jane.
As he arrived, he soon discover the jane had her second divorce and many things has changed from the last visit.
With Jane relationship breaking apart from her 4 daughters,
she asks Alex for help to figure out the problems and bond back the family.
Dive in the story of Alex and his critical visit to help his aunt and discovers her daughters issues.
Throught it Alex also goes to changes himself emotionaly, physically, and Sexually​
translation:
来认识一下视觉小说中的主角亚历克斯。与同龄的青少年不同，
他喜欢和他最喜欢的阿姨简一起度过假期。
当他到达时，他很快发现简已经第二次离婚，许多事情与上次拜访相比发生了变化。
随着简与4个女儿的关系破裂，
她向亚历克斯寻求帮助，以解决问题并重建家庭关系。
深入了解亚历克斯的故事，以及他为帮助姨妈而进行的重要访问，并发现她女儿的问题。
通过它，亚历克斯也在情感、身体和性方面改变了自己​
